owner_approval.evidence: Owner asked in chat: step 1 (liquidity filter, illiquid stocks as their own group) and step 2 (add Ward, PCA+K-Means, multi-metric selection) in a new experiment run, write a report, wait for approval.

liquidity_filter.definition: zero_volume_share_63 = sessions with volume <= 0 or missing in the last 63 sessions up to the snapshot date / 63; liquidity_21 as served (mean traded value, VND)
liquidity_filter.note: Thresholds are an eligibility (business) choice set from the 2025-12-31 distribution only, never from cluster metrics. The owner picks the level.

feature_sets.C_base: A_base on liquid tickers (December) + B_base same fiscal year, equal block variance

derived_features.downside_vol_63: sqrt(mean(min(r,0)^2)) * sqrt(252) over the last 63 adj_close daily returns

transform: T1: log1p(liquidity_21 and log_market_cap kept as is), winsorize p1/p99, z-score, fitted per snapshot

stability.measure: ARI between the full fit and a refit on the subsample, on subsample rows

selection_rule: Within each (family, filter, feature set): among admissible configs, mean rank over five metrics - median silhouette (high), median Davies-Bouldin (low), median Calinski-Harabasz (high), median subsample stability (high), median temporal ARI between consecutive screening snapshots (high). Lowest mean rank wins; ties -> smaller k, then kmeans, pca_kmeans, ward, gmm. Metrics computed in the T1 space of that feature set. Illiquid tickers are excluded from all metrics and shares. Returns/Sharpe never used.
promotion: No automatic promotion; served bundle v2 unchanged until owner approval.
